body: Hm I supposed Prophecy should be part of the "shared API", hence completely whitelisted. @sebastianfeldmann I think you can leverage the namespace whitelisting feature for that one.

Well, maybe not all Prophecy, but at least the `Prophecy\Argument\Token`, `Prophecy\Promise` and `Prophecy\Prediction` namespaces, as these are the public API of configuring test doubles, which can be used in tests
And the `\Prophecy\Argument` class too, which is an entrypoint to `Prophecy\Argument\Token` with helper methods.

Also `\Prophecy\Doubler\DoubleInterface` should be whitelisted, to avoid breaking code trying to detect the fact that it is a test double (the symfony/debug component will skip warning about extending `@final` or `@deprecated` classes when the child class is a known test double for instance)

I'm not entirely sure what the reasonable thing to do would be.
For simplicity reasons I'm tempted to leave the `Prophecy\*` Namespaces as is, since it belongs to the testing API. Even if not provided by PHPUnit itself.

And prefixing some Prophecy stuff and whitelisting some other can cause problems the Prophecy developers would not experience in their development process.

Any objections?

issue.title: Add 'Prophecy' namespace to the scoping whitelist
issue.body:
In oder to setup or check test doubles with Prophecy it has to be
part of the public API of PHPUnit, even it not provided by PHPUnit
itself.

Issues:
- #3578 - Scoped PHAR Prophecy issue

body:

Being one of the maintainers who might get reports for broken code, I have absolutely no objection for a full whitelisting :smile:
